messages:
Nora (Docs): hey team, opened a small PR that attempts to consolidate the SLA matrix for Dedicated reserved vs burst, plus a tiny CLI example for creating a reserved pool. can someone sanity-check the SLA lines and the example flags? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1489 :wave:
Sam (Eng Docs): link looks good, will review. pinging Diego about correctness on the CLI flags and on the suggestion to mention `isolation_level` tradeoffs.
Diego (Infra): quick read: SLA phrasing should avoid absolute guarantees for burst. Suggest: "Reserved: baseline throughput guaranteed per contract. Burst: opportunistic, subject to pool & regional capacity; may be throttled during contention." Also, the CLI flag is `--eviction-priority` (not `--eviction_priority`) and allowed values are low, medium, high.
Nora (Docs): good catch on flag naming. current CLI snippet in PR is:
```bash
redwoodctl dedicated create-pool \
  --name gpu-large \
  --min-instances 2 \
  --max-instances 10 \
  --eviction_priority low
```
Diego (Infra): please change to `--eviction-priority low`. Also we added `--isolation-level` flag recently; valid values: tenant,node,gpu. Might add a note that `gpu` isolation pins an entire GPU to a tenant (higher cost).
Priya (Product): from product POV, can we add a one-line example SLA snippet in the docs table that maps to commit sizes? e.g., "SLA: 99.5% baseline throughput per reserved instance under normal regional capacity" — but we should run that by legal. For now maybe phrase as soft numbers: "Typical baseline: 99x%"? Not ideal.
Sam (Eng Docs): let's avoid putting explicit percent values in the quickstart. We can link to the official SLA doc instead and add a footnote: "See SLA reference for contract terms". That keeps legal happy.
Nora (Docs): ack. I'll remove percent and link to /handbook/dedicated/slas.md. redwood-docs-bot: link check found `/handbook/dedicated/slas.md` -> 404. Suggest linking to `/handbook/enterprise/slas/dedicated.md` instead.
Nora (Docs): thanks bot. will update link.
Diego (Infra): minor: the YAML example in the PR uses `eviction_policy: immediate` which isn't a valid value. Valid `eviction_policy` values: graceful, immediate, delayed (explain delayed triggers a cooldown). Could we show both graceful and immediate with small notes?
Nora (Docs): good idea. I'll add two tiny YAML snippets and annotate.
Sam (Eng Docs): also consider adding a small callout about fallback routing: fallback to hosted API is subject to tenant opt-in and routing policy thresholds (latency_slo). Otherwise customers on Private/Dedicated won't appreciate surprise routing.
Priya (Product): yes include the 'enterprise opt-out' callout. Also suggest a short blurb explaining billing implications when burst is used vs reserved. e.g., "Burst usage billed at on-demand rates; reserved billed under commitment." keep it short.
Nora (Docs): will add a billing line and link to pricing. Also adding the CLI fix and isolation note. Draft snippet I'll add to PR:
```yaml
# reserved pool config example
name: gpu-large
min_instances: 2
max_instances: 10
eviction_policy: graceful  # options: graceful, immediate, delayed
eviction_priority: low     # low|medium|high
isolation_level: node      # tenant|node|gpu
```

And CLI example:
```bash
redwoodctl dedicated create-pool \
  --name gpu-large \
  --min-instances 2 \
  --max-instances 10 \
  --eviction-priority low \
  --isolation-level node
```
Diego (Infra): LGTM for snippets. One more nuance: when `eviction_policy: delayed` we set a cooldown window (default 300s). maybe add parenthetical so users know it's tunable.
Nora (Docs): good point, I'll add `(cooldown default: 300s; configurable)` next to delayed.
redwood-docs-bot: CI: broken link found in PR - `docs/dedicated/quickstart.md` references `/handbook/dedicated/reserved-pools.md` which should be `/handbook/dedicated/reserved-pools-guide.md`.
Nora (Docs): will update that path too.
Sam (Eng Docs): can someone leave a single quick review after you push updates? I'm hoping to merge today. small request: add a changelog line under docs/CHANGELOG.md noting "clarify SLA/billing language, update CLI flags, add isolation examples".
Priya (Product): I'll review the SLA/billing blurb once pushed. Thanks for iterating quickly.
Nora (Docs): thanks everyone. pushing updates now, will ping when PR is updated. If anything else pops up, ping me in-thread.
